estimates.rationale: Foundational persistence + boundary/service/repository layering, unique (sku,location) invariant, plus a full E2E UI slice (form, validation, empty-to-filled state).
In-place optimistic update (R5) with below-zero rejection (R2) and audit timestamp/actor (R1); adds mutation logic and inline error UI on top of FP1's model.
Supplier-attributed inbound event with its own entity/form; increments an existing stock row, so it builds on FP1's layering but adds a distinct receipt flow and UI.
Outbound pick drawing stock down with transactional no-overcommit enforcement (R2 at write time) and inline shortfall messaging; comparable scope to FP3 with stricter invariant.
Read/aggregation slice reusing FP1's persistence: a SKU detail view listing multiple location rows; largely a query + UI increment with no new write path.
